Take a shelter dog out for the day in Alabama

Want to rent or borrow a dog in Alabama? These shelters let you take an adoptable dog on a day trip, hike or sleepover for free. 11 shelter programs in Alabama, 5 of them open to the public. Cities include Auburn, Columbiana, Dothan, Fairhope, Huntsville, Madison, Troy, Tuscaloosa and more.

ShelterDayOut is a free directory. We don't run outings or handle bookings; each shelter sets its own rules. Listings are checked monthly, but details change, so confirm with the shelter before you go.

Ready to adopt? ShelterAdoption, our sister site, lists every shelter near you plus upcoming adoption events.
